runs.arrivalText: Estimated arrival December 2026 · subject to import approval · 10 weeks old
steps: Message us.Tell us which puppy and which boy or girl you'd like. We confirm availability, usually within 24 to 48 hours, before you pay anything.

Pay the 50% deposit (S$2,275).To reserve, you pay a deposit of 50% of the price by PayNow or bank transfer, after we have confirmed availability. We send your written reservation confirmation, with the breeder's name, the price, the estimated arrival date and the refund terms, within 1 business day of receiving the deposit. We pay the breeder only after your deposit has cleared.

Pay the balance (S$2,275) before the flight.The remaining 50% (the balance) is due before the puppy flies, after we have sent you written confirmation of the booked flight, the puppy's pre-export vet check, and copies of its vaccination, worming and microchip records.
Welcome home.Your puppy lands, clears AVS checks at Changi, and we deliver to your door with the 30-item starter kit and set everything up with you.
